newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pacifica, UPMC said up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pacifica, UPMC said up on speculative buying.

text.p: Manila third-liner stocks Pacifica Inc and United Paragon Mining Co (UPMC) led the most active gainers by midsession on Monday on speculative buying, brokers said.
Oil concern Pacifica is rumoured to be the object of a possible takeover by a big Indonesian firm, traders said.
Pacifica officials were not immediately available to comment.
Local investors were buying up United Paragon after it announced a significant gold discovery recently, traders added.
Pacifica rose 0.75 centavos, or 8.57 percent, to 9.50 centavos, while United Paragon added 0.20 centavos, or 10 percent, to 2.20 centavos by midsession.
"The buying was being spurred by the same old stories," Jonas Ferrer, research head of Pryce Securities, said.
